title: 7 Verses a Godly Man Reaches for Before His Phone
caption:
The phone wins most nights because nothing gets there first. Try putting a verse in front of it instead.

Seven to keep close: Psalm 119:37, Philippians 4:8, 1 Corinthians 6:12, Galatians 5:1, James 1:14, Romans 12:2, Psalm 46:10.

Not a rule to feel guilty about breaking. A line to reach for in the three seconds before your thumb finds the app on its own.

Save this one. You'll want it tonight.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #scripture #digitalminimalism
